source: 566 Gathered Clues
target: 566 Indicia Congregata

source: 566 Gathered Clues
target: 566 Indicia Congregata

source: Solow Motel.
target: Deversorium Solow.

source: Lumian gazed at the red flames in the port district, tuning in to the distant commotion, anticipating potential visitors.
target: Lumian flammis rubris in regione portuaria intueri coepit, strepitum remotum auscultans et futuros hospites exspectans.

source: Before long, a knock echoed on the door.
target: Mox pulsus in ostio resonavit.

source: Lumian didn’t wait for Lugano to wake up.
target: Lumian Lugano evigilandi non exspectavit.

source: He pivoted and strode to the door.
target: Se vertit et ad ostium properavit.

source: The moment he swung it open, Noelia, clad in brown leather armor and a wimple, stood before him.
target: Mox, cum ostium aperuerit, Noelia, quae lorica coriacea fusca et pallio induta erat, coram eo stetit.

source: Noelia’s expression was as cold as ice.
target: Vultus Noeliae tam frigidus quam glacies erat.

source: She abruptly raised her hand and uttered ancient Hermes words, “Imprison!”
target: Subito manum levavit et antiqua verba Hermetica edixit: "Include!"

source: Lumian found himself instantly immobilized.
target: Lumian se statim immobilis invenit.

source: Transparent walls or a viscous liquid seemed to encase him, turning him into an insect trapped in amber.
target: Muri transparentes vel liquidum viscosum, quasi eum circumdantes, videbantur, eum in insectum in succino inclusum convertentes.

source: In the next second, Noelia unsheathed a straight sword from her back.
target: In secundo proximo, Noelia gladium rectum de tergo suo extulit.

source: Simultaneously, Lumian’s pants tightened, as if he had grown taller and more robust.
target: Simul, bracae Luminiani contraxerunt, quasi altior et robustior fuisset.

source: An explosive force emanated from his body.
target: Vis explosiva ex corpore eius emanabat.

source: The transparent “amber” restraining him creaked, revealing invisible cracks.
target: Succinum transparentem, quod eum retinebat, striduit, fissuras invisibiles revelans.

source: With a whoosh, Noelia clutched the hilt of her straight sword with both hands, slicing through the air, carving through the already shaky “prison,” aiming for Lumian’s head.
target: Cum fremitu, Noelia manubrium gladii recti utrisque manibus arripuit, per aethera secans et per carceram iam vacillam incidens, ad caput Luminiani tendens.

source: Lumian’s right fist, ready to strike, collided with the side of the straight sword, a condensed crimson, almost white flame accompanying the impact.
target: Pugna dextra Luminiani, ad ictum parata, ad latus gladii recti incidit, flamma rubra concentrata, paene alba, ictum comitante.

source: Amidst a deep and controlled explosion, the straight sword slanted, grazing the door frame as it descended to the ground.
target: Inter profundam et moderatam explosionem, gladium rectum inclinavit, limen ostii leviter tangens, dum in terram descendebat.

source: Taking advantage of the situation, Noelia retreated, sheathed her sword, and inquired in Intisian, “Were you the one who blew up the Fisheries Guild?”
target: Ex opportunitate usus, Noelia recessit, gladium reponens, et in lingua Intisiana interrogavit: "An tu fuisti qui Collegium Piscatorum explosisti?"

source: Upon witnessing this, Lumian refrained from retaliation.
target: Hoc videns, Lumian ultionem abstinuit.

source: His body returned to its normal state as he smiled and replied, “It doesn’t matter if I blew it up. What matters is whether anyone can prove it.”
target: Corpus eius ad statum suum normalem rediit dum arridebat et respondit: "Non refert, si id explosi sim; refert, an quis id probare possit."

source: He understood that Noelia had issued a warning and wasn’t truly targeting him.
target: Intelligit Noeliam monitionem edidisse ac eum non vere propositum esse.

source: Otherwise, she would have employed other Beyonder powers after the “Imprison” instead of slashing with her sword.
target: Alioquin alias potentias Beyonder post "Include" adhibuisset, quam gladium secare.

source: Noelia, upholding the dignity of maintaining order in Port Santa throughout the year, used a questioning tone typical for various suspects.
target: Noelia, dignitatem ordinis in Port Santa per totum annum conservans, tono quaesitivo, qui a variis suspectis notus est, usus est.

source: “Why did you go to such lengths? Why did you cause such a commotion?”
target: "Cur adeo conatus es? Cur talem tumultum excitavisti?"

source: Lumian turned his head, signaling Lugano, who had awakened at the commotion, to return to sleep in the servant’s room.
target: Lumian caput vertit, Luganoque, qui ex tumultu evigilaverat, indicans, ut in cubiculo servorum ad somnum rediret.

source: Walking toward the recliner in the living room, he ignored Noelia’s question and smiled.
target: Ad lectum in triclinio ambulans, quaestionem Noeliae neglexit et arridebat.

source: “I’ve discovered something.”
target: "Aliquid reperi."

source: “Like what?”
target: "Quid?"

source: Noelia entered the suite and closed the wooden door behind her.
target: Noelia in conclave intravit et ianuam ligneam post se clausit.

source: Lumian motioned toward the divan.
target: Lumian ad divanum indicavit.

source: “Let’s have a seat and talk.
target: "Sedeamus et colloquamur.

source: “I wouldn’t want you accusing me of being impolite.”
target: "Nolo ut me inurbanum suspicias."

source: Noelia glanced at Lumian and grinned.
target: Noelia ad Luminianum respexit et subridens animadvertit.

source: “What kind of politeness is there without greeting me by pressing your cheek against mine?”
target: "Quale est urbanitas, nisi me salutaveris genam tuam ad meam apposendo?"

source: Her demeanor was direct.
target: Habitus eius directus erat.

source: Lumian eased into the recliner and responded to the question, “For instance, last year’s sea prayer ritual failed.”
target: Lumian in lectum reclinabilem se accommodavit et quaestioni respondit: "Exempli gratia, ritus orationis maris anni superioris defecit."

source: Noelia didn’t display surprise.
target: Noelia stuporem non demonstravit.

source: She sat on the edge of the divan, leaning forward slightly to avoid the straight sword on her back from jabbing her.
target: In margine divani sedit, leviter inclinata, ne gladium rectum in tergo suo eam percuteret.

source: “What else?”
target: "Quid aliud?"

source: Lumian pondered for a moment and casually remarked, “Also, the sea prayer ritual is a marriage to the sea.
target: Lumian paulo meditatus fuit et leviter asseruit: "Praeterea, ritus orationis maris matrimonium cum mari est."

source: “Furthermore, the Governor of the Sea is the husband of the sea, and the Maidens of the Sea embody the sea in the real world.
target: "Praeterea, praefectus maris est sponsus maris, et virgines maris in mundo reali mare incarnant."

source: “Whether it’s the Governor of the Sea or the Maidens of the Sea, the offspring they bear are the Children of the Sea.
target: "Sive praefectus maris sive virgines maris, proles quae oriuntur sunt filii maris."

source: “The first one possesses the purest bloodline…”
target: "Primum ex eis purissimam sanguinis stirpem possidet..."

source: Though Lumian was well aware that the offspring of the women the Governor of the Sea had slept with were descendants of the sea, whether they were Maidens of the Sea or not, with his profound mystical knowledge and extraordinary insights, he couldn’t help but consider that the Governor of the Sea having his children on his own was also part of the equation.
target: Quamquam Lumian bene sciebat prolem feminarum, cum quibus Praefectus Maris cubuit, ex mari descendere, sive virgines maris essent sive non, cum profunda scientia mystica et perspicaciis extraordinariis usus esset, non potuit non cogitare quod etiam ipsi, Praefecto Maris filios solum generanti, pars rei haberent.

source: Phew, as expected, the more you know, the easier it is to be corrupted.
target: Eheu, ut exspectabatur, quanta scias, tanto facilius corrumpitur.

source: I wouldn’t have thought so in the past…
target: Numquam antea ita putavi...

source: Lumian sighed inwardly.
target: Lumian intus suspiravit.

source: Noelia, in surprise and admiration, sighed.
target: Noelia, stupefacta et admiratione afflata, suspiravit.

source: “You’ve made faster progress in your investigation than I anticipated.”
target: "Progressus in investigatione tua celerior fuit quam exspectavi."

source: “Most of it pieced together in such a short time.”
target: "Plerumque in tam brevi tempore composita est."

source: It’s been quite a while.
target: Iam diu praeteriit.

source: My Language Comprehension charm will expire tomorrow.
target: Carmen meum ad intellectum linguae cras exspirabit.

source: I wonder how much I’ll retain from this enhanced week of study…
target: Miror quantum ex hac hebdomade studii aucta retinebo...

source: Lumian grinned and teased, “Don’t tell me you think my reputation as a great adventurer was just boasting?”
target: Lumian subridens et ludens respondit: "Noli mihi dici te famam meam ut magni viatoris solum iactationem fuisse?"

source: “Claiming a bounty of 300,000 gold risot for the Demon Warlock certainly isn’t a boast,” Noelia diplomatically acknowledged, indicating she didn’t underestimate someone capable of hunting down such a target.
target: "Fama mercedis trecentis milibus auri risot pro Daemoni Warlock vindicata certe non est iactatio," Noelia diplomate agnuit, ostendens se neminem subestimasse qui talem metam venari posset.

source: Content, she nodded and continued, “While many Beyonders wield impressive abilities, their intelligence often falls short.
target: Contenta, annuit et perrexit: "Quamquam multi Beyonderes facultates admirabiles possident, eorum intelligentia saepe deficit."

source: “They revel in belligerence and flaunt their might, but you’re not one of them.
target: "Se in pugnacitate delectant et potentiam ostendunt, sed tu inter eos non es."

source: “Still, I must caution you not to push too far.
target: "Tamen moneo te ne nimis procedas."

source: “Despite understanding your true motive for stirring up this commotion, we must uphold peace and order in Port Santa.
target: "Quamquam verum propositum tuum ad hanc tumultum excitandum intellexi, pacem et ordinem in Port Santa servare debemus."

source: “Don’t make things difficult for us.”
target: "Nolite nobis res difficiles efficere."

source: Coupled with the warning, the implication is that you shouldn’t disrupt Port Santa’s current situation.
target: Coniuncta cum monitione, insinuitas est ut statu praesenti Port Santae non perturbes.

source: You’re free to investigate the sea prayer ritual, but stirring up trouble with the Fisheries Guild is a no-go.
target: Licet tibi ritum orationis maris investigare, sed tumultum cum Collegio Piscatorum excitare prohibitum est.

source: What exactly does your Church of Earth Mother aim for?
target: Quid quidem finem habet Ecclesia Matris Terrae tuae?

source: It seems like there’s a mixed desire—both wanting and not wanting some actions to be taken…
target: Videtur esse desiderium mixtum—et quidam actiones fieri vel non fieri velle...

source: Lumian contemplated Noelia’s hint, a smile playing on his lips as he spoke, “If you had been more forthcoming, I wouldn’t have had to work this hard.”
target: Lumian insidias Noeliae meditatus est, subrisus labris, et dixit: "Si magis aperta fuisisses, non tam diligenter laborare mihi oporteret."

source: Noelia offered a polite yet awkward smile.
target: Noelia, comiter sed dubie, subridens se ostendit.

source: “We lack extensive intel.
target: "Notitia ampla nobis deest.

source: “All I can say is the Church allows the sea prayer ritual and the Fisheries Guild to obtain power from the sea for a reason, unrelated to our ability to solve it.
target: "Omnia quae dicere possum, sunt: Ecclesia ritum orationis maris et Collegium Piscatorum ad potentiam ex mari obtinendam sinit, ob causam a nostra solutione alienam."

source: “I’m not privy to the reason—perhaps the Archbishop or our Fertility Order president could shed light.”
target: "Rationem nescio—fortasse Archiepiscopus aut praeses Ordinis Fertilitatis lumen inferre possit."

source: Lumian scoffed and said, “Then why allow my investigation of the sea prayer ritual?”
target: Lumian deridens dixit: "Quare igitur investigationi meae ritus orationis maris sinere?"

source: With a sigh, Noelia replied, “Do we need to know? We didn’t pry into your true motives for probing the ritual, did we?”
target: Cum suspiriis, Noelia respondit: "Necesse est id scire? Non penetramus in veros motus tuos ad ritum explorandum, nonne?"

source: With that, the combat nun swiftly rose from the sofa, striding purposefully towards the suite’s door.
target: Hoc dictis, monialis pugnax celeriter ex sofa surrexit et ad ianuam conclavis propositam properavit.

source: After a few steps, she halted, a thoughtful expression crossing her face.
target: Post paucos passus, sistit, vultu meditativo apparenti.

source: “There are ancient traces concealed in the basement of the Governor of the Sea’s residence in Milo Village.
target: "Antiquae vestigia in subterram domus Praefecti Maris in vico Milo absconsa sunt.

source: They might unveil something crucial.
target: "Fortasse aliquid maximi momenti revelabunt.

source: It’s best to seize an opportunity to investigate.”
target: "Optimum est occasionem investigandi capere."

source: In the subterranean chamber beneath the Governor of the Sea’s residence?
target: "In cella subterranea sub domo Praefecti Maris?"

source: According to Franca’s account, Milo Village’s ancestors had left behind symbols and patterns.
target: Secundum narrationem Francae, maiores vici Milo signa et exempla reliquerunt.

source: Does Noelia suggest these hold vital information?
target: Num Noelia sugerit haec notitiam vitalem continere?

source: Is the reason for the Church of Earth Mother knowingly allowing the occurrence of the sea prayer ritual hidden in that chamber?
target: Num causa cur Ecclesia Matris Terrae conscie sinat ritus orationis maris evenire, in ea cella abscondita sit?

source: If Juan Oro isn’t deceptive or concealing the truth, and isn’t engaging in foul play, doesn’t that imply that the Earth Mother Church possesses a deeper understanding of Milo Village’s ancestors than their own descendants?
target: Si Juan Oro non sit fallax nec veritatem celat, et pravis artibus non utatur, nonne hoc significat Ecclesiam Matris Terrae altiori ratione de maioribus vici Milo posse quam ipsi posteri?

source: It makes sense.
target: Sane.

source: After all, they once obliterated Milo Village and eradicated the faction of those ancestors.
target: Nam quondam vicum Milo deleverunt et factionem eorum maiorum exterminaverunt.

source: Over the past thousand years, there has been no disruption in the legacy, maintaining a prominent position in the real world.
target: Per mille annos, hereditas sine intermissione permanet, locum praeclarum in mundo reali tenens.

source: Lumian observed Noelia’s departure without pressing further.
target: Lumian discessum Noeliae observavit, ulteriora non rogans.

source: As he returned to the master bedroom, preparing for sleep, the “doll” messenger dropped a folded piece of paper, swiftly departing without a greeting.
target: Dum ad cubiculum principalem redibat, ad somnum se parans, nuntius "pupa" chartam plicatam deiecit, celeriter abscedens sine salutando.

source: Ludwig isn’t that repulsive, except for being a bit ravenous and devouring everything, right?
target: Ludwig non est tam abhorens, nisi quod paulum vorax sit et omnia devorat, nonne?

source: Uh, Madam Magician does tend to stay up late.
target: Heu, Domina Magica sero manere solet.

source: She’s quickest with her replies at night…
target: Nocte celerime responsa dat…

source: Lumian muttered under his breath as he picked up the response.
target: Lumian submurmuravit dum responsum arripiebat.

source: Swiftly unfolding it, he scanned the contents.
target: Celeriter evolvens, contentum perlustrare coepit.

source: “Your performance in Port Santa has been impressive thus far.
target: "Exsecutio tua in Port Santa usque nunc mirabilis fuit.

source: “I won’t interfere or provide excessive guidance.
target: "Non immiscor nec nimiam praeceptionem praebebo."

source: “This is a prime chance for you to further digest the Conspirer potion.
target: "Haec est praecipua occasio ut poculum Conspiratoris ulterius digeras."

source: “I’ve roughly reconstructed that sentence and read it multiple times.
target: "Illam sententiam fere recontexi et pluries legi."

source: “It’s not in any language I know presently, but what I can confirm is its lack of natural power.
target: "Non est in lingua quam nunc novi, sed quod certo scire possum, eam naturali potentiae carere."

source: “However, it possesses a certain energy—language can possess such energy.
target: "Attamen, quandam energiam habet—lingua enim talem energiam habere potest."

source: “What does this imply?
target: "Quid hoc implicat?"

source: “It means that during the sea prayer ritual, it can’t serve as a sacrificial language or communicate with Beyonder items—in simpler terms, the sea.
target: "Hoc significat tempore ritu orationis maris, eam lingua sacrificatoria esse non posse nec cum rebus Beyonder communicare—simpliciter, mare."

source: “So why does the sea prayer ritual work?
target: "Quare ergo ritus orationis maris operatur?"

source: “The key may lie within the ceremonial ring.
target: "Clavis fortasse in anulo caerimoniali sita est."

source: “There’s a high chance it has a distinct appearance, peculiar patterns, strong spirituality, and embedded knowledge.
target: "Multa verisimilitudo est ut formam distinctam, figuras peculiares, spiritualitatem fortem, et scientiam inclusam habeat."

source: “The sentence relies on its pronunciation, structure, and energy to activate the ring, making it functional.
target: "Sententia in eius pronuntiatu, structura, et energia fundatur, quae anulum ad operandum excitant."

source: “If you can recreate the ring’s state after the vigil ritual, I’m confident I can decode its specific effects and approximate meaning.”
target: "Si statum anuli post ritum vigili refigere potes, certo confido me effectus specificos eius et sensum approximatum interpretari posse."

source: That makes sense.
target: Id sensum habet.

source: When Lato Guiaro recited the words ‘We espouse thee, O sea…’ there were no indications of natural power being invoked.
target: "Cum Lato Guiaro verba 'Te adnutimus, O mare…' recitavit, nullae significationes naturae potentiae adhibitae erant."

source: It must serve a different purpose…
target: "Aliud proposito fungitur…"

source: Lumian gained a deeper understanding of the sea sacrificial segment after reading Madam Magician’s explanation.
target: Lumian altorem comprehensionem de parte sacrificii maris adeptus est postquam explanationem Dominae Magicae legit.

source: Most of the clues seemed to await his infiltration of the Governor of the Sea’s residence.
target: Plerumque indicia videbantur eum exspectare, dum in domum Praefecti Maris infiltraretur.

source: The next morning, Lugano led Ludwig through the streets, grabbing breakfast according to the boy’s cravings.
target: Mane sequenti, Lugano Ludovicum per vias duxit, prandium iuvenis cupiditatibus secundum capiens.

source: Out of nowhere, someone hurriedly passed by, head lowered, and seemingly slipped, accidentally bumping into him.
target: Ex nihilo, aliquis festinanter transivit, capite inclinato, quasi lapsus, casu in eum incidens.

source: Lugano smoothly shifted his body, preventing the person from making contact.
target: Lugano leniter se commutavit, impediens ut persona eum contingere posset.

source: He went the extra mile, helping the individual up and hypocritically saying, “Be careful.”
target: Extra studium induxit, hominem ad surgendum adiuvans et hypocrite dicens, "Cave!"

source: The man quickly pressed something into Lugano’s hand,
target: Vir celeriter aliquid in manum Lugani imposuit,

source: muttered an apology, and seamlessly melted into the crowd.
target: murmurans veniam dedit, et in turbam leniter se dissolvit.

source: Lugano glanced down at his palm, revealing a crumpled white post-it note.
target: Lugano in manum suam intuitus est, schedulam albam conglobulatam revelans.

source: Unrushed, he didn’t immediately read the note.
target: Non celeriter, schedulam statim legere non instituit.

source: After securing breakfast for Ludwig, he returned to Solow Motel and briefed Lumian.
target: Post prandium pro Ludovico curatum, ad Deversorium Solow rediit et Luminiano enarrauit.

source: Lumian took the crumpled note, unfolding it with a nonchalant gesture.
target: Lumian schedulam conglobulatam sumpsit, eam leviter evolvens.

source: In delicate handwriting, it conveyed: “After last year’s ritual, the sea experienced an anomaly.”
target: Sub subtili calamo scriptum, nuntiabat: "Post ritum anni superioris, mare anomaliam passi est."
